docs.title: plot-finder
docs.text:
Find land parcels across Europe by id, address or coordinates — one API, one object.

plot-finder wraps the official open cadastre of each supported country behind a single Plot class. You pick the country, pass a query, and get back a normalized parcel with geometry, area, centroid and country-specific attributes.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="PL", plot_id="141201_1.0001.6509")
plot.voivodeship   # 'mazowieckie'  — country attribute (from the Poland class)
plot.area          # 6509.0         — shared, computed from geometry
plot.centroid      # (x, y)

docs.title: Supported countries
docs.text:
Coordinates are lon/lat (EPSG:4326) everywhere; geometry is returned in EPSG:4326 by default (set srid= for another output CRS).

Country country Attribute class Data source Coordinates Poland 🇵🇱 "PL" Poland ULDK / GUGiK lon/lat (EPSG:4326) France 🇫🇷 "FR" France IGN apicarto cadastre lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Spain 🇪🇸 "ES" Spain Dirección General del Catastro lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Netherlands 🇳🇱 "NL" Netherlands PDOK Kadaster lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Switzerland 🇨🇭 "CH" Switzerland swisstopo / geo.admin.ch lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Estonia 🇪🇪 "EE" Estonia Maa-amet lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Cyprus 🇨🇾 "CY" Cyprus DLS (Lands & Surveys) lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Lithuania 🇱🇹 "LT" Lithuania Registrų centras (geoportal.lt) lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Latvia 🇱🇻 "LV" Latvia VZD (kadastrs.lv) lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Portugal 🇵🇹 "PT" Portugal DGT SNIC lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Slovenia 🇸🇮 "SI" Slovenia GURS (e-prostor) lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Italy 🇮🇹 "IT" Italy Agenzia delle Entrate lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Germany 🇩🇪 "DE" Germany state ALKIS / INSPIRE (10 states) lon/lat (EPSG:4326) Norway 🇳🇴 "NO" Norway Kartverket (Matrikkelen) lon/lat (EPSG:4326)

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
pip install plot-finder

Requirements: Python 3.10+ · pydantic httpx shapely pyproj

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
country is required and selects which cadastre to query. Every country has a matching class in plot_finder.countries (Poland, France, Spain, Netherlands) that:

  1. defines the country-specific attributes (e.g. voivodeship, department),
  2. knows how to fetch a parcel from that country's API.

The Plot sources those attributes from the matching class and exposes them flat, next to the shared fields:

Plot(country="FR", x=-0.5792, y=44.8378).department   # from the France class
Plot(country="ES", x=-3.6999, y=40.4211).province      # from the Spain class

docs.title: Three ways to query
docs.text:
Every country supports the same three entry points (details and formats differ per country — see each page):

Plot(country="PL", plot_id="...")                 # by cadastral id / reference
Plot(country="PL", x=639231, y=486743)            # by coordinates
Plot(country="PL", address="Warszawa, ...")       # by address (geocoded)

Addresses are geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim; you must provide at least one of plot_id, address, or both x and y.

docs.title: Shared properties
docs.text:
Regardless of country, every Plot exposes:

Property Type Description geojson dict Geometry as GeoJSON area float Geodesic area in m² (WGS84 ellipsoid) centroid (float, float) Centroid of the geometry bbox (float, float, float, float) Bounding box (minx, miny, maxx, maxy)

docs.title: Coordinate systems
docs.text:
Input coordinates are lon/lat (EPSG:4326) for every country. Geometry is returned as geojson in EPSG:4326 by default; set srid for another output CRS:

Plot(country="PL", x=21.0122, y=52.2297)             # geometry in EPSG:4326
Plot(country="PL", x=21.0122, y=52.2297, srid=2180)  # geometry in EPSG:2180

docs.title: Serialization
docs.text:
Plot is a Pydantic v2 model, so a parcel round-trips to plain data:

plot.model_dump()        # flat dict: common fields + country attributes + computed props
plot.model_dump_json()   # JSON string

docs.title: Errors
docs.text:
from plot_finder import (
    PlotNotFoundError,     # no parcel for the given query
    AddressNotFoundError,  # geocoder returned no result
    ULDKError,             # Poland (ULDK) API failure
    IGNError,              # France (IGN) API failure
    CatastroError,         # Spain (Catastro) API failure
    KadasterError,         # Netherlands (PDOK Kadaster) API failure
    GeoAdminError,         # Switzerland (geo.admin.ch) API failure
    MaaametError,          # Estonia (Maa-amet) API failure
    DLSError,              # Cyprus (DLS) API failure
    RCError,               # Lithuania (geoportal.lt) API failure
    VZDError,              # Latvia (VZD) API failure
    DGTError,              # Portugal (DGT SNIC) API failure
    GURSError,             # Slovenia (GURS) API failure
    AdEError,              # Italy (Agenzia delle Entrate) API failure
    ALKISError,            # Germany (state ALKIS) API failure
    KartverketError,       # Norway (Kartverket) API failure
)

See the reference for the full field list and model details.

docs.title: Cyprus 🇨🇾
docs.text:
Parcels in Cyprus come from the Department of Lands and Surveys (DLS) via its public INSPIRE ArcGIS service. Geometry is returned in EPSG:4326.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="CY", plot_id="1000-21/450301-1-1-290")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By referenceBy coordinatesBy address

The plot_id is the national cadastral reference (district-sheet/plan-quarter-block-parcel), e.g. 1000-21/450301-1-1-290.

Plot(country="CY", plot_id="1000-21/450301-1-1-290")

Coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326).

Plot(country="CY", x=33.3396, y=35.1787)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="CY", address="Nicosia, Cyprus")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Cyprus class (parsed from the cadastral reference):

Attribute Meaning Example district_code district block 1000 sheet plan sheet 21 plan plan number 450301 parcel_number parcel number 290

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:32636 (UTM zone 36N) and matches the DLS areaValue.
  • Administrative names (district/village) are numeric codes in the parcel record; only the reference components are exposed.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When DLSError a DLS request failed or returned invalid data PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point / for the reference AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Estonia 🇪🇪
docs.text:
Parcels in Estonia come from the Maa-amet (Estonian Land Board) cadastre WFS (kataster:ky_kehtiv), which returns the parcel geometry together with the county, municipality and settlement in a single call.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="EE", plot_id="78401:114:0086")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By id (katastritunnus)By coordinatesBy address

The plot_id is the cadastral unit identifier katastritunnus (e.g. 78401:114:0086).

Plot(country="EE", plot_id="78401:114:0086")

Input coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326) by default. Pass in_srid=3301 for L-EST97 coordinates.

Plot(country="EE", x=24.7536, y=59.437)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="EE", address="Viru väljak 4, Tallinn")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Estonia class:

Attribute Estonian term Example county maakond Harju maakond municipality omavalitsus Tallinn settlement asustusüksus Kesklinna linnaosa

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is the geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid; it matches the Land Board's official pindala within rounding.
  • The WFS uses North/East axis order for coordinate filters; plot-finder handles the transformation internally.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When MaaametError a Maa-amet WFS request failed PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point / for the katastritunnus AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: France 🇫🇷
docs.text:
Parcels in France come from the IGN apicarto cadastre API (documentation), served by the Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. Geometry is returned as GeoJSON in longitude / latitude (EPSG:4326).

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="FR", plot_id="33063000KE0078")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By id (IDU)By coordinatesBy address

The identifier is the 14-character cadastral IDU, laid out as code_insee(5) + com_abs(3) + section(2) + numero(4).

Plot(country="FR", plot_id="33063000KE0078")

Coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326). The API returns the parcel whose geometry contains the point.

Plot(country="FR", x=-0.5792, y=44.8378)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="FR", address="30 Rue Sainte-Catherine, Bordeaux")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the France class:

Attribute Meaning Example department department code (code_dep) 33 insee commune INSEE code 33063 commune commune name Bordeaux section cadastral section KE numero parcel number 0078

Plus the shared fields: plot_id (IDU), geom_wkt, datasource, and the computed area / centroid / geojson.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:2154 (RGF93 / Lambert-93), the French metric reference system.
  • Coordinates are always lon, lat — a common mistake is to swap them.

Paris, Lyon and Marseille

For these three cities the IDU carries the arrondissement code instead of the base commune INSEE, so id lookup does not work. Use coordinates or an address for parcels in Paris, Lyon or Marseille.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When IGNError the apicarto request failed or returned invalid data PlotNotFoundError no parcel matched the id / coordinates AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Germany 🇩🇪
docs.text:
Germany's cadastre (Liegenschaftskataster / ALKIS) is run per federal state, with no national API. plot-finder routes a lookup to the right state's INSPIRE WFS (determined from the point), then parses the parcel. Geometry is returned in EPSG:4326.

Coordinates / address only, and 10 of 16 states

Lookup works by coordinates or address only (state services differ too much for a uniform id lookup). Free services cover 10 states: Nordrhein- Westfalen, Berlin, Brandenburg, Niedersachsen, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Sachsen, Sachsen-Anhalt, Thüringen, Bremen, Hamburg. The other six (Bayern, Baden-Württemberg, Hessen, Rheinland-Pfalz, Schleswig-Holstein, Saarland) are paid/restricted and raise ALKISError.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="DE", x=6.9583, y=50.9413)   # Köln

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By coordinatesBy address

Input coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326).

Plot(country="DE", x=6.9583, y=50.9413)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="DE", address="Domkloster 4, Köln")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Germany class:

Attribute Meaning Example land state code 05 (NRW) gemarkung cadastral district 4958 / Mitte flur field/section 030 parcel_number Zähler/Nenner 344/17

The plot_id is the state's Flurstückskennzeichen (e.g. 054958030003440017__).

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:3035 (LAEA Europe, equal-area) so it is accurate across both German UTM zones.
  • The state is detected from the point via reverse geocoding; attribute detail varies by state (INSPIRE CP, ALKIS-vereinfacht, or Berlin's own schema).

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When ALKISError a state WFS failed, an unsupported state, or a plot_id lookup PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Italy 🇮🇹
docs.text:
Parcels in Italy come from Agenzia delle Entrate (Catasto) via its INSPIRE Cadastral Parcels WFS. Geometry is returned in EPSG:4326.

Coordinates / address only

The Agenzia delle Entrate WFS does not allow filtering by cadastral reference, so Italy supports lookup by coordinates or address only — a plot_id lookup raises AdEError.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="IT", x=12.4922, y=41.8902)

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By coordinatesBy address

Input coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326). The parcel containing the point is selected.

Plot(country="IT", x=12.4922, y=41.8902)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim (resolves to a parcel only when the point falls inside one — not on a road or square).

Plot(country="IT", address="Piazzale degli Uffizi, Firenze")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Italy class:

Attribute Meaning Example comune_code comune cadastral (Belfiore) code H501 (Roma) foglio sheet 0508 particella parcel number B

The plot_id is the full NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE, e.g. H501A050800.B.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:25832 (ETRS89 / UTM 32N); no official area is published by the service.
  • Coverage: nationwide except the autonomous provinces of Trento and Bolzano, whose cadastre is provincial.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When AdEError a WFS request failed, or a plot_id lookup was attempted PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Latvia 🇱🇻
docs.text:
Parcels in Latvia come from Valsts zemes dienests (VZD, State Land Service) via its public INSPIRE Cadastral Parcels WFS. Geometry is returned in EPSG:4326.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="LV", plot_id="01000540120")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By id (kadastra apzīmējums)By coordinatesBy address

The plot_id is the 11-digit parcel designation kadastra apzīmējums (e.g. 01000540120).

Plot(country="LV", plot_id="01000540120")

Coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326). Pass in_srid=3059 for LKS-92 coordinates.

Plot(country="LV", x=24.0917, y=56.9276)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="LV", address="Rīga, Latvia")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Latvia class (parsed from the designation):

Attribute Meaning Example territory_code cadastral territory 0100 group_code cadastral group 054 parcel_number parcel number 0120

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:3059 (LKS-92 / Latvia TM) and matches the VZD areaValue.
  • The WFS uses lat/lon axis order for coordinate filters; plot-finder handles it internally.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When VZDError a VZD WFS request failed PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point / for the designation AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Lithuania 🇱🇹
docs.text:
Parcels in Lithuania come from Registrų centras via the national INSPIRE geoportal (geoportal.lt). Geometry is returned in EPSG:4326.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="LT", plot_id="0101/0041:0121")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By id (kadastro numeris)By coordinatesBy address

The plot_id is the cadastral number kadastro numeris (e.g. 0101/0041:0121).

Plot(country="LT", plot_id="0101/0041:0121")

Coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326). Pass in_srid=3346 for LKS-94 coordinates.

Plot(country="LT", x=25.27904, y=54.68449)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="LT", address="Gedimino pr. 1, Vilnius")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Lithuania class:

Attribute Meaning Example cadastral_zone cadastral zone (label prefix) 0101 municipality_code savivaldybė code 13 purpose land use purpose Other, 995

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:3346 (LKS-94) and matches the official plotas.
  • The WFS uses lat/lon axis order for coordinate filters; plot-finder handles it internally.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When RCError a geoportal.lt WFS request failed PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point / for the kadastro numeris AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Netherlands 🇳🇱
docs.text:
Parcels in the Netherlands come from the Kadaster via PDOK (Publieke Dienstverlening Op de Kaart), the national open-data platform. plot-finder uses two PDOK services:

  1. Locatieserver — resolves a cadastral designation (or address) to a point.
  2. Kadastrale Kaart WFS (kadastralekaartv5:Perceel) — returns the parcel polygon and attributes for the point.
from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="NL", plot_id="AKM01 K 3785")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By designationBy coordinatesBy address

The plot_id is the kadastrale aanduiding — cadastral municipality code, section and parcel number, e.g. AKM01 K 3785 (also accepts AKM01-K-3785). It is resolved through the PDOK Locatieserver.

Plot(country="NL", plot_id="AKM01 K 3785")

Input coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326) by default. Internally they are converted to RD New (EPSG:28992) to query the WFS. Pass in_srid=28992 to provide RD coordinates directly.

Plot(country="NL", x=4.6255, y=52.1987)                 # (lon, lat)
Plot(country="NL", x=102923, y=468116, in_srid=28992)   # RD New

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="NL", address="Dam 1, Amsterdam")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Netherlands class:

Attribute Dutch term Example municipality kadastrale gemeente Alkemade section sectie K parcel_number perceelnummer 3785

Plus the shared fields: plot_id (kadastrale aanduiding), geom_wkt, datasource, and the computed area / centroid / geojson.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:28992 (Amersfoort / RD New), the Dutch metric reference system, and matches the Kadaster's kadastrale grootte.
  • Coordinate queries select the parcel whose polygon contains the point, which is robust near shared boundaries.
  • Geometry is returned in RD New and reprojected to lon/lat WKT.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When KadasterError a Locatieserver / WFS request failed PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point / for the designation AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Norway 🇳🇴
docs.text:
Parcels in Norway come from Kartverket (the Norwegian Mapping Authority) via the Matrikkelen "Eiendomskart Teig" WFS on Geonorge. Geometry is returned in EPSG:4326.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="NO", plot_id="0301-209/494")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By id (matrikkelnummer)By coordinatesBy address

The plot_id is kommunenr-gnr/bnr (municipality, gårdsnummer, bruksnummer), e.g. 0301-209/494.

Plot(country="NO", plot_id="0301-209/494")

Input coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326).

Plot(country="NO", x=10.7330, y=59.9116)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="NO", address="Karl Johans gate 1, Oslo")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Norway class:

Attribute Meaning Example municipality kommune name OSLO municipality_code kommunenummer 0301 gnr gårdsnummer 209 bnr bruksnummer 494

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is the geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid; it matches the official Matrikkelen lagretBeregnetAreal within rounding.
  • The Kartverket WFS is GML-only and needs an XML POST filter — handled internally.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When KartverketError a Kartverket WFS request failed PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point / for the matrikkelnummer AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Poland 🇵🇱
docs.text:
Parcels in Poland come from the ULDK service of GUGiK (Główny Urząd Geodezji i Kartografii), the national mapping authority. The service returns the parcel geometry together with the full administrative breakdown (voivodeship → county → commune → cadastral region → parcel).

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="PL", plot_id="141201_1.0001.6509")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By id (TERYT)By coordinatesBy address

The parcel identifier is the TERYT number.

Plot(country="PL", plot_id="141201_1.0001.6509")

Input coordinates are read in EPSG:2180 (the Polish national grid). Pass in_srid= for another input CRS.

Plot(country="PL", x=639231, y=486743)                # EPSG:2180 input
Plot(country="PL", x=21.0, y=52.2, in_srid=4326)      # lon/lat input

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim, then resolved to a parcel.

Plot(country="PL", address="Warszawa, Marszalkowska 1")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Poland class and exposed flat on the plot:

Attribute Polish term Example voivodeship województwo mazowieckie county powiat powiat m. Warszawa commune gmina Warszawa (miasto) region obręb ewidencyjny Śródmieście parcel numer działki 6509

Plus the shared fields: plot_id (TERYT), geom_wkt, geom_extent, datasource, and the computed area / centroid / geojson.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:2180. If the parcel was fetched in another CRS (e.g. srid=4326), the geometry is reprojected before measuring.
  • The ULDK service accepts geographic coordinates too — passing srid=4326 simply forwards it to the API.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When ULDKError the ULDK request failed or returned an unexpected response PlotNotFoundError no parcel matched the id / coordinates AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Portugal 🇵🇹
docs.text:
Parcels in Portugal come from the DGT SNIC (Sistema Nacional de Informação Cadastral, Direção-Geral do Território). Geometry is returned in EPSG:4326.

Partial coverage

Portugal's cadastre is incomplete. SNIC covers mostly the rural centre and south of the mainland — major cities (Lisbon, Porto, Coimbra) and the north return no parcel, and a lookup there raises PlotNotFoundError.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="PT", plot_id="AAA000825807")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By id (NIC)By coordinatesBy address

The plot_id is the NIC (Número de Identificação de Prédio), e.g. AAA000825807.

Plot(country="PT", plot_id="AAA000825807")

Coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326). The parcel containing the point is selected.

Plot(country="PT", x=-7.7079, y=40.4210)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim (only resolves inside the cadastred area).

Plot(country="PT", address="Seia, Portugal")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Portugal class:

Attribute Portuguese term Example municipality concelho SEIA parish freguesia Seia, São Romão e Lapa dos Dinheiros district_code código dico 0912

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:3763 (ETRS89 / PT-TM06) and matches the SNIC official area_m2.
  • Coverage is partial — always handle PlotNotFoundError.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When DGTError a DGT SNIC request failed PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point / for the NIC (or outside coverage) AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: The Plot object
docs.text: Plot is a Pydantic v2 model. Constructing one triggers a lookup against the selected country's cadastre and fills in the geometry and attributes.

docs.title: Construction
docs.text:
Plot(
    country,          # required: "PL"|"FR"|"ES"|"NL"|"CH"|"EE"|"CY"|"LT"|"LV"|"PT"|"SI"|"IT"|"DE"|"NO"
    plot_id=None,     # cadastral id / reference / designation
    address=None,     # free-form address (geocoded)
    x=None, y=None,   # lon/lat coordinates (EPSG:4326)
    srid=4326,        # output geometry CRS
)

Rules:

  • country is required — there is no default.
  • Provide one of: plot_id, address, or both x and y.
  • Input coordinates are always lon/lat (EPSG:4326) for every country.
  • srid is the output geometry CRS — 4326 by default, set it for another.

docs.title: Common fields
docs.text: Field Type Description country str Country code, echoed back plot_id str Cadastral identifier for the country address str \| None The input address, if one was given x, y float \| None Input coordinates srid int Output geometry CRS (default 4326) geojson dict Parcel geometry as GeoJSON datasource str Human-readable origin of the data

docs.title: Computed properties
docs.text: Property Type Description area float Geodesic area in m² (WGS84 ellipsoid) centroid (float, float) Centroid of the geometry bbox (float, float, float, float) Bounding box (minx, miny, maxx, maxy)

docs.title: Country attributes
docs.text:
The remaining attributes depend on country and come from the matching class in plot_finder.countries:

Country Attributes Poland voivodeship, county, commune, region, parcel France department, insee, commune, section, numero Spain province, municipality Netherlands municipality, section, parcel_number Switzerland canton, municipality, egrid, parcel_number Estonia county, municipality, settlement Cyprus district_code, sheet, plan, parcel_number Lithuania cadastral_zone, municipality_code, purpose Latvia territory_code, group_code, parcel_number Portugal municipality, parish, district_code Slovenia ko_code, ko_name, municipality, parcel_number Italy comune_code, foglio, particella Germany land, gemarkung, flur, parcel_number Norway municipality, municipality_code, gnr, bnr

They are exposed flat on the plot and included in model_dump():

p = Plot(country="PL", x=639231, y=486743)
p.voivodeship          # 'mazowieckie'
p.model_dump().keys()  # common fields + country attributes + computed props

docs.title: Serialization
docs.text:
p.model_dump()        # dict
p.model_dump_json()    # JSON string

Both include the common fields (geojson included), the country attributes and the computed area / centroid / bbox.

docs.title: Exceptions

docs.title: Slovenia 🇸🇮
docs.text:
Parcels in Slovenia come from GURS (Geodetska uprava RS) via the e-prostor Kataster nepremičnin (KN) WFS. Geometry is returned in EPSG:4326.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="SI", plot_id="1725-3283/1")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By id (KO + parcel)By coordinatesBy address

The plot_id is the cadastral municipality code (katastrska občina) plus the parcel number, e.g. 1725-3283/1 (also accepts 1725 3283/1).

Plot(country="SI", plot_id="1725-3283/1")

Input coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326). Pass in_srid=3794 for D96/TM coordinates.

Plot(country="SI", x=14.50582, y=46.05144)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="SI", address="Prešernov trg 1, Ljubljana")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Slovenia class:

Attribute Meaning Example ko_code katastrska občina code 1725 ko_name KO code + name 1725 AJDOVŠČINA municipality občina Ljubljana parcel_number parcelna številka 3283/1

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:3794 (D96/TM) and matches the GURS official površina.
  • The municipality (občina) is fetched from a second GURS layer — best effort.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When GURSError a GURS WFS request failed PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point / for the id AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Spain 🇪🇸
docs.text:
Parcels in Spain come from the Dirección General del Catastro (DGC). Because no single endpoint returns everything, plot-finder combines three official services:

  1. Consulta_RCCOOR — coordinates → cadastral reference (referencia catastral).
  2. INSPIRE WFS (GetParcel) — reference → parcel geometry + official area.
  3. Consulta_DNPRC — reference → province and municipality.
from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="ES", plot_id="0749407VK4704H")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By referenceBy coordinatesBy address

The plot_id is the referencia catastral (14 characters for the parcel).

Plot(country="ES", plot_id="0749407VK4704H")

Coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326). They are resolved to a cadastral reference via RCCOOR, then to geometry.

Plot(country="ES", x=-3.6999, y=40.4211)   # (lon, lat)

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="ES", address="Calle de Alcalá 1, Madrid")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Spain class:

Attribute Spanish term Example province provincia MADRID municipality municipio MADRID

Plus the shared fields: plot_id (referencia catastral), geom_wkt, datasource, and the computed area / centroid / geojson.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:25830 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 30N). It matches the Catastro's official superficie to within a fraction of a percent.
  • The INSPIRE WFS returns geometry as GML in lat/lon axis order; plot-finder normalizes it to standard lon/lat WKT.
  • The geometry request uses the 14-character parcel reference; a longer 20-char property reference is truncated to its parcel part.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When CatastroError an RCCOOR / WFS request failed or returned invalid data PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point / for the reference AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded

docs.title: Switzerland 🇨🇭
docs.text:
Parcels in Switzerland come from swisstopo via the federal geoportal geo.admin.ch. plot-finder uses the identify / find services on the cadastral web map layer, plus the municipality-boundary layer for the commune name.

from plot_finder import Plot

plot = Plot(country="CH", plot_id="CH119192997709")

docs.title: Querying
docs.text:
By id (EGRID)By coordinatesBy address

The plot_id is the EGRID — the federal parcel identifier (e.g. CH119192997709), unique across the whole country.

Plot(country="CH", plot_id="CH119192997709")

Input coordinates are longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326) by default. Pass in_srid=2056 to provide LV95 (CH1903+) coordinates.

Plot(country="CH", x=8.5417, y=47.3769)                  # (lon, lat)
Plot(country="CH", x=2683400, y=1247500, in_srid=2056)   # LV95

The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Plot(country="CH", address="Bundesplatz 3, Bern")

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Sourced from the Switzerland class:

Attribute Meaning Example canton canton abbreviation ZH municipality commune name Zürich egrid federal parcel id CH119192997709 parcel_number cantonal parcel number AA8048

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Area is computed in EPSG:2056 (CH1903+ / LV95), the Swiss metric reference system. Geometry is returned in EPSG:4326.
  • The cadastral layer carries the canton and EGRID; the commune name is fetched from the swissboundaries3d municipality layer at the parcel centroid.
  • parcel_number is only unique within a municipality — use the egrid as the stable identifier.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text: Exception When GeoAdminError a geo.admin.ch request failed PlotNotFoundError no parcel at the point / for the EGRID AddressNotFoundError the address could not be geocoded
